changes: Pinned Clang/LLD/WASI browser proof and documented tested capabilities and limits.
Moved compilation, linking and execution into a dedicated Worker with a fresh filesystem per job.
Added CppCompiler lifecycle, compile/run, cancellation, reset and disposal.
Added canonical virtual paths, detached snapshots and deterministic multi-file compilation.
Verified compile/run results, streams, stdin, exit codes and transferred Wasm artifact ownership.
Added structured Clang diagnostics and a limited, validated C++ standard/optimization/warning option set.
Added Worker watchdogs, resource/capture bounds, stale-generation protection and malformed-response handling.
Added a static package build, asset integrity verification, packaged-output browser smoke tests and consumer documentation.
